sources.name: lang-uk/name_freq_dict_uk — lname_freq_dict.csv (Ukrainian surname lexical dictionary)
sources.population: Ukrainian surname list crossed with Ukrainian corpus-word lemma occurrences; includes historic/biographical names, NOT a population registry or birth statistics
sources.method: 500 distinct source-observed surname lemmas in source corpus ordering; source frequency ignored. Source Cyrillic transformed with Ukraine Cabinet of Ministers Resolution 55 (2010) without any Cyrillic output.
sources.license: Upstream repository GPL-3.0; corpus/name-list data rights and suitability for redistribution require separate review
sources.limitations: Corpus named-entity and tokenization errors remain possible; lexical inclusion does not independently verify current residency.

sources.name: Ukraine Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No 55 of 27 January 2010
sources.method: Official 2010 Ukrainian Cyrillic-to-Latin transliteration; initial Є/Ї/Й/Ю/Я context, зг -> zgh, soft sign/apostrophe omission

sources.name: lang-uk Ukrainian surname lexical source — extended to 3,000
sources.method: Retained original 500 values verbatim and appended 2,500 new source-observed distinct surname entries, excluding equivalent existing Romanized renderings. Romanized using official Ukraine Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 55 (2010); no source frequencies imported.
sources.population: Lexical+text-corpus Ukrainian surname entries; NOT population-wide citizen census, not newborn names
sources.license: GPL-3.0 code; upstream Wikimedia/ubertext corpus data reuse and surname redistribution require review.
sources.limitations: Corpus may contain person names appearing in media, historic and non-resident persons; original cyrillic is not stored; lexical source does not prove current residence.
sources.transliteration: Resolution 55 (2010): initial Є=Ye/else ie; Ї=Yi/else i; Й=Y/else i; Ю=Yu/else iu; Я=Ya/else ia; ЗГ=zgh, Ґ=g, Г=h, Х=kh, Щ=shch; apostrophe and soft sign omitted.
